input.quote: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 give us 30-day data return in machine-readable format and certified deletion, but 11.1 mandates immediate cessation of assistance and immediate permanent deletion with no export — the walk-away case, and internally inconsistent with 11.2/11.3. Replaced 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and deletion only per 11.2/11.3.
